title: AWS Lambda consumer for Amazon MSK with IAM authentication (Java)
description: The function consumes from an Amazon Managed Streaming for Apache Kafka (Amazon MSK) cluster that uses IAM access control. The cluster is attached as a self-managed Apache Kafka event source with the IAM_AUTH authentication type, so the event source mapping signs each connection with the function's execution role, and IAM policies grant access to the cluster, topic, and consumer group.

introBox.headline: How it works
text: Amazon MSK with IAM authentication: the event source mapping signs each connection with the function's execution role (IAM_AUTH), and IAM policies authorize access to the cluster, topic, and consumer group.

The AWS CloudFormation template MSKAndClientEC2.yaml creates the Kafka cluster and an Amazon EC2 client instance; the AWS Lambda function and its event source are deployed with AWS SAM or the AWS CLI.
The function decodes each Kafka record, logs it to Amazon CloudWatch Logs, and writes its fields to Amazon DynamoDB.
For detailed deployment instructions, see the README.md.
